evidence.content: Hi Taylor, I'm putting together a training packet outline for a cohort of 32 on July 8. The modules are account setup, data handling, and incident reporting, and it will be delivered as a PDF. Since the packet needs to be usable by the entire invited cohort, do you have any accessibility recommendations or quality considerations I should include?
The accessibility coordinator knows that several participants use screen readers and recommends tagged headings, descriptive links, and alt text for diagrams.
